interpretation: All submitted operations committed and no handler errors were recorded under the simulator's 30% pre-receiver request-drop model. The offered rate was 10,000 operations/sec, but measured throughput was 2,394.27 operations/sec; the 10k sustained-throughput target was not achieved.
limitations: The drop simulator drops requests before receiver processing; this is not a real network partition or arbitrary packet corruption test.
The run used a 3-CPU container, so results are environment-specific.
The benchmark is a finite 10,000-operation run, not a sustained soak test.
The 30% loss result depends on bounded retries and stable operation IDs.
